A type of '''transport''' was in commercial use during the early days of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. In the aftermath of the [[Ghost Prison incident|Headmaster Gentis's military coup]], one of those shuttles was provided to the former convicts of [[the Prism]], who had helped the Empire liberate [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. However, [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] and [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Laurita Tohm]] had sabotaged the transport beforehand, and it exploded shortly after taking off with the prisoners.
